description: Records a stage the user reports on their own tracker. Nothing is sent to the employer.

application_ids.description: Application ids to act on, 1 to 25 (e.g. [1550, 1551]), from getmattered_get_applications

stage.description: The stage to record: applied, callback, phone_screen, interview, offered, rejected or no_response.

name: getmattered_set_application_stage

decision.description: The operation that ran, one of approve, reject, cancel, refine, re_prepare or set_stage.

notConfirmed.description: True when the user declined the confirmation prompt and nothing was sent.

reason.description: Machine reason when ok is false, or "already_approved" for an approve that had already gone through.

status.description: Our own record after the action, which is not proof the employer received it.

setupStep.description: Present while account setup is open: the first setup step.

title: Record Application Stage
